svg.title: F404-class afterburning turbofan — cutaway
svg.desc: Side view of a low-bypass afterburning turbofan: upper half sectioned along the gas path with stations 2, 25, 3, 4, 5 and 7; lower half external with the accessory gearbox, FADEC and sensor harness.
svg.text: SECTION ON THE ENGINE AXIS · ACCESSORIES BELOW
stations: 2 fan face · 25 HPC inlet · 3 HPC exit · 4 HPT inlet · 5 LPT exit · 7 nozzle inlet
